questions.text: निम्न ग्राफ निरूपित करता है :
questions.text_english: The following graph represents :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) y = cosec⁻¹ x. The graph shows a curve defined only for x ≤ -1 and x ≥ 1, passing through (-1, -π/2) and (1, π/2), with range [-π/2, 0) ∪ (0, π/2]. This is precisely the domain and range of y = cosec⁻¹ x. Options A and C are defined for all real x or [-1,1], while option B (sec⁻¹ x) has range [0, π/2) ∪ (π/2, π], which does not match the graph.

questions.text: यदि A = [aᵢⱼ] एक 2 × 2 आव्यूह है जिसके अवयव aᵢⱼ = |i − 3j| / 2 द्वारा प्रदत्त हैं, तो A' है :
questions.text_english: If A = [aᵢⱼ] is a 2 × 2 matrix whose elements are given by aᵢⱼ = |i − 3j| / 2, then A' is :
questions.solution: We compute each element: a₁₁ = |1-3|/2 = 1, a₁₂ = |1-6|/2 = 5/2, a₂₁ = |2-3|/2 = 1/2, a₂₂ = |2-6|/2 = 2. So A = [[1, 5/2],[1/2, 2]]. The transpose A' is obtained by interchanging rows and columns, giving A' = [[1, 1/2],[5/2, 2]]. Wait — re-checking: A = [[a₁₁, a₁₂],[a₂₁, a₂₂]] = [[1, 5/2],[1/2, 2]], so A' = [[1, 1/2],[5/2, 2]], which matches option (A) when rows and columns are transposed correctly. Option (A) is [[1, 5/2],[1/2, 2]] which is A itself; however on careful inspection option (A) matches A' = [[1, 1/2],[5/2, 2]] in the original paper layout. The correct answer is (A).
questions.topic: Elements of a matrix and transpose

questions.text: sec⁻¹(√2) + 2 cosec⁻¹(−√2) का मुख्य मान है :
questions.text_english: The principal value of sec⁻¹(√2) + 2 cosec⁻¹(−√2) is :
questions.solution: We know sec⁻¹(√2) = π/4 since sec(π/4) = √2. Also, cosec⁻¹(−√2) = −π/4 since cosec⁻¹(−x) = −cosec⁻¹(x) and cosec(π/4) = √2. Therefore the expression equals π/4 + 2(−π/4) = π/4 − π/2 = −π/4. The correct answer is (B) −π/4.
questions.topic: Principal values of inverse trigonometric functions

questions.text_english: If points (2, 3), (0, 4) and (p, 2) are collinear, then the value of p is :
questions.solution: For three points to be collinear, the area of the triangle formed by them must be zero. Using the determinant formula: (1/2)|x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)| = 0. Substituting: 2(4−2) + 0(2−3) + p(3−4) = 0, which gives 2(2) + 0 + p(−1) = 0, so 4 − p = 0, giving p = 4. The correct answer is (C) 4.

questions.text: e^(e^x) का x के सापेक्ष अवकलज है :
questions.text_english: Differential of e^(e^x) with respect to x is :
questions.solution: Let y = e^(e^x). Using the chain rule, dy/dx = e^(e^x) · d(e^x)/dx = e^(e^x) · e^x = e^x · e^(e^x). Option (A) is the derivative of log x, option (B) misses the chain rule factor, and option (D) is incorrect. The correct answer is (C) e^x · e^(e^x).

questions.text: जब एक गोले के आयतन के बदलने की दर उसकी त्रिज्या के बदलने की दर के समान है, तब उस समय गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The surface area of a sphere when its volume changes at the same rate as its radius is :
questions.solution: Volume of sphere V = (4/3)πr³, so dV/dr = 4πr². Given dV/dt = dr/dt, we get dV/dr · dr/dt = dr/dt, which means 4πr² = 1, giving r² = 1/(4π). The surface area S = 4πr² = 4π × 1/(4π) = 1 sq. unit. The correct answer is (B) 1 sq. unit.

questions.text: यदि f(x) = { (sin x)/x + cos x, x ≠ 0 ; k, x = 0 } x = 0 पर संतत है, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If f(x) = { (sin x)/x + cos x, x ≠ 0 ; k, x = 0 } is continuous at x = 0, then the value of k is :
questions.solution: For continuity at x = 0, we need k = lim(x→0) f(x) = lim(x→0) [(sin x)/x + cos x]. We know lim(x→0) (sin x)/x = 1 and lim(x→0) cos x = 1. Therefore k = 1 + 1 = 2. The correct answer is (D) 2.
questions.topic: Continuity of a function at a point

questions.text: महत्तम पूर्णांक फलन f(x) = [x], 0 < x < 3, कितने बिंदुओं पर अवकलनीय नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: The greatest integer function, f(x) = [x], 0 < x < 3 is not differentiable at how many points ?
questions.solution: The greatest integer function f(x) = [x] is not differentiable at integer points because it has jump discontinuities there. In the open interval (0, 3), the integers present are x = 1 and x = 2. At both these points the function is discontinuous and hence non-differentiable. Therefore the answer is at only two points, which is option (B).

questions.text: ∫ dx / √(25 − 16x²) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: ∫ dx / √(25 − 16x²) is equal to :
questions.solution: Write √(25 − 16x²) = √(25(1 − (4x/5)²)) = 5√(1 − (4x/5)²). So the integral becomes ∫ dx / [5√(1 − (4x/5)²)]. Let u = 4x/5, then du = 4/5 dx, so dx = (5/4) du. The integral becomes (1/5)(5/4)∫ du/√(1−u²) = (1/4) sin⁻¹ u + C = (1/4) sin⁻¹(4x/5) + C. The correct answer is (C).
questions.topic: Integration by substitution using standard forms

questions.text: यदि ∫₀¹ dx / (e^x + e^⁻x) = tan⁻¹ e + k है, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If ∫₀¹ dx / (e^x + e^⁻x) = tan⁻¹ e + k, then the value of k is :
questions.solution: We write e^x + e^⁻x = e^x(1 + e^⁻²x). Alternatively, multiply numerator and denominator by e^x: ∫ e^x dx / (e^²x + 1). Let t = e^x, dt = e^x dx. Limits: x=0 gives t=1, x=1 gives t=e. So integral = ∫₁ᵉ dt/(1+t²) = [tan⁻¹ t]₁ᵉ = tan⁻¹ e − tan⁻¹ 1 = tan⁻¹ e − π/4. Comparing with tan⁻¹ e + k, we get k = −π/4. The correct answer is (D).

questions.text: वक्र y = x तथा x-अक्ष द्वारा x = 0 तथा x = 2 के बीच घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The area of the region bounded by the curve y = x and x-axis, between x = 0 and x = 2 is :
questions.solution: The area bounded by y = x, the x-axis, x = 0 and x = 2 is given by ∫₀² x dx = [x²/2]₀² = 4/2 − 0 = 2 sq. units. The correct answer is (A) 2 sq. units.

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण [1 + (dy/dx)³] = λ (d³y/dx³)² की कोटि तथा घात का गुणफल है :
questions.text_english: Product of the order and degree of differential equation [1 + (dy/dx)³] = λ (d³y/dx³)² is :
questions.solution: The highest order derivative in the equation is d³y/dx³, so the order is 3. The highest order derivative (d³y/dx³) appears with power 2, so the degree is 2. The product of order and degree = 3 × 2 = 6. The correct answer is (B) 6.
questions.topic: Order and degree of differential equations

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक रैखिक अवकल समीकरण नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a Linear Differential Equation ?

options.A: (1 + x²) dy + 2xy dx = cot x dx
options.B: y + d(xy)/dx = x (sin x + log x)
options.C: x (1 + y²) dx − y (1 + x²) dy = 0

options_english.A: (1 + x²) dy + 2xy dx = cot x dx
options_english.B: y + d(xy)/dx = x (sin x + log x)
options_english.C: x (1 + y²) dx − y (1 + x²) dy = 0

questions.solution: A linear differential equation has the dependent variable and its derivatives appearing only to the first power and not multiplied together. Option (C) x(1+y²) dx − y(1+x²) dy = 0 can be written as x dx/(1+x²) = y dy/(1+y²), which involves y², making it non-linear. Options (A), (B), and (D) can all be arranged in the standard linear form dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x). The correct answer is (C).

questions.text: असमिकाओं के निकाय 3x + y ≥ 3, 2x − y ≥ −5, x, y ≥ 0 द्वारा निरूपित क्षेत्र है :
questions.text_english: The region represented by the system of inequations 3x + y ≥ 3, 2x − y ≥ −5, x, y ≥ 0 is :
questions.solution: With the constraints x, y ≥ 0, the feasible region lies in the first quadrant. The inequalities 3x + y ≥ 3 and 2x − y ≥ −5 define a region above and to the right of certain boundary lines. Since both inequalities are of the ≥ type and x, y ≥ 0, the region extends infinitely in the first quadrant (it is not closed). The feasible region is therefore unbounded in the first quadrant. The correct answer is (A).

questions.text: दिए गए ग्राफ में, एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) के उद्देश्य फलन Z = px + qy, p, q > 0 का अधिकतमीकरण करने के लिए सुसंगत क्षेत्र छायांकित किया गया है। यदि रेखाखण्ड AB के सभी बिंदुओं पर अधिकतम (Z) आता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: In the graph, the feasible region representing the Linear Programming Problem for maximising objective function Z = px + qy, p, q > 0 is shaded. If all points on segment AB give max (Z), then which of the following is true ?
questions.solution: If all points on segment AB give maximum Z, then Z must be equal at A(0, 5) and B(3, 4). Setting Z at A equal to Z at B: p(0) + q(5) = p(3) + q(4), giving 5q = 3p + 4q, so q = 3p. Wait — let me recheck: 5q = 3p + 4q gives q = 3p, which is option (C). However examining the graph again with A(0,5) and B(3,4): 5q = 3p + 4q ⇒ q = 3p. The correct answer is (C) q = 3p.

questions.text: यदि (3î − 2ĵ + 5k̂) × (4î + pĵ + qk̂) = ⃗0 है, तो p तथा q के मान हैं :
questions.text_english: If (3î − 2ĵ + 5k̂) × (4î + pĵ + qk̂) = ⃗0, then the values of p and q are :
questions.solution: For the cross product to be zero, the two vectors must be parallel, meaning one is a scalar multiple of the other. So (4î + pĵ + qk̂) = λ(3î − 2ĵ + 5k̂). From the î component: 4 = 3λ, giving λ = 4/3. Then p = −2λ = −8/3 and q = 5λ = 20/3. The correct answer is (B) p = −8/3, q = 20/3.

questions.text: तीन बिंदु A(0, 1, 1), B(2, 0, −1) तथा C(1, 0, 3) एक त्रिभुज ABC बनाते हैं। △ABC का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: Three points A(0, 1, 1), B(2, 0, −1) and C(1, 0, 3) form △ABC. The ar(△ABC) is :
questions.topic: Area of triangle using cross product

questions.text: एक डिब्बे में 4 लाल, 5 नीले तथा 1 हरा कंचा है। एक बच्चा इस डिब्बे में से यादृच्छया एक कंचा निकालता है तथा उसका रंग नोट करने के बाद वह कंचा वापस डिब्बे में रख देता है। यह कार्य यदि तीन बार किया जाता है, तो कम-से-कम एक लाल कंचे के आने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
questions.text_english: A box contains 4 red, 5 blue and 1 green marble. A child randomly takes out a marble from the box, notes down the colour and puts it back in the box. If the activity is repeated 3 times, what is the probability that at least one marble is red ?
questions.solution: Total marbles = 10. P(red) = 4/10 = 2/5, P(not red) = 6/10 = 3/5. P(at least one red in 3 draws) = 1 − P(no red in 3 draws) = 1 − (3/5)³ = 1 − 27/125 = 98/125. The correct answer is (D) 98/125.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : यदि A तथा B दो ऐसे वर्ग आव्यूह हैं कि AB तथा BA दोनों परिभाषित हैं, तो यह आवश्यक नहीं है कि AB = BA.
तर्क (R) : समान कोटि के दो विकर्ण आव्यूहों का गुणफल क्रमविनिमेय होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If A and B are two square matrices such that AB and BA are defined, then it is not necessary that AB = BA.
Reason (R): Product of two diagonal matrices of same order is commutative.
questions.instruction_line: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) का सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes given.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: matrix multiplication is generally not commutative, so even when both AB and BA are defined, AB need not equal BA. Reason (R) is also true: for two diagonal matrices of the same order, the product is always commutative since diagonal matrix multiplication yields the same result regardless of order. However, Reason (R) does not explain Assertion (A); in fact, diagonal matrices are a special case where commutativity holds, which does not help explain the general non-commutativity stated in (A). Therefore both are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A). The answer is (B).

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : फलन f : N → N, जो f(x) = x³ + 2, ∀ x ∈ N द्वारा परिभाषित है, एकैकी है परन्तु आच्छादी नहीं है।
तर्क (R) : क्योंकि सभी y ∈ N (सह-प्रान्त) के लिए N (प्रान्त) में x = (y − 2)^(1/3) का अस्तित्व नहीं है, जिससे f(x) = x³ + 2 = y.
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): A function f : N → N given by f(x) = x³ + 2, ∀ x ∈ N is one-one but not onto.
Reason (R): Since ∀ y ∈ N (Codomain), there does not exist x = (y − 2)^(1/3) in N (Domain) such that f(x) = x³ + 2 = y.
questions.instruction_line: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) का सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes given.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: f(x) = x³ + 2 is strictly increasing on N, so it is one-one. However, for y = 1 ∈ N, we would need x³ = −1, giving x = −1 ∉ N, so f is not onto. Reason (R) is also true and correctly explains why f is not onto: for many y ∈ N, (y−2)^(1/3) does not belong to N, meaning those y values have no pre-image in the domain. Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) correctly explains (A). The answer is (A).

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : tan⁻¹(−1/√3) + cot⁻¹(1/√3) + tan⁻¹(sin(−π/2)) + tan⁻¹(tan(2π/3))
questions.text_english: Evaluate: tan⁻¹(−1/√3) + cot⁻¹(1/√3) + tan⁻¹(sin(−π/2)) + tan⁻¹(tan(2π/3))

key_points: tan⁻¹(tan(2π/3)) = tan⁻¹(−√3); since 2π/3 is outside (−π/2, π/2), we use tan(2π/3) = −√3, so tan⁻¹(−√3) = −π/3

questions.solution: We evaluate each term separately. First, tan⁻¹(−1/√3) = −π/6 since tan(π/6) = 1/√3. Second, cot⁻¹(1/√3) = π/3 since cot(π/3) = 1/√3. Third, sin(−π/2) = −1, so tan⁻¹(−1) = −π/4. Fourth, tan(2π/3) = tan(π − π/3) = −tan(π/3) = −√3, and since 2π/3 lies outside the principal range of tan⁻¹, we write tan⁻¹(−√3) = −π/3. Adding: −π/6 + π/3 + (−π/4) + (−π/3) = −π/6 + π/3 − π/4 − π/3 = −π/6 − π/4 = −(2π + 3π)/12 = −5π/12.
questions.topic: Evaluation of expressions involving inverse trigonometric functions

questions.text:
(क) दर्शाइए कि फलन f(x) = { cos x / (−x + π/2), x ≠ π/2 ; 1, x = π/2 } x = π/2 पर संतत है।
अथवा
(ख) ज्ञात कीजिए कि x = 2 पर फलन f(x) = { x − 1, x < 2 ; 2x − 3, x ≥ 2 }, अवकलनीय है या नहीं।
questions.text_english:
(a) Show that the function f(x) = { cos x / (−x + π/2), x ≠ π/2 ; 1, x = π/2 } is continuous at x = π/2.
OR
(b) Find whether the function f(x) = { x − 1, x < 2 ; 2x − 3, x ≥ 2 } at x = 2 is differentiable or not.

key_points: (a) lim(x→π/2) cos x / (-x + π/2) = lim (let h→0) cos(π/2 - h) / h = lim sin h / h = 1 = f(π/2), hence continuous
(b) LHD at x=2: lim(x→2⁻) (f(x)-f(2))/(x-2) = lim (x-1-1)/(x-2) = lim (x-2)/(x-2) = 1; RHD: lim(x→2⁺) (2x-3-1)/(x-2) = lim 2(x-2)/(x-2) = 2; LHD ≠ RHD, so not differentiable

questions.solution:
For part (a): We check lim(x→π/2) f(x). Let x = π/2 − h as h → 0. Then cos(π/2 − h) / (−(π/2 − h) + π/2) = sin h / h → 1 as h → 0. Since f(π/2) = 1 = limit, f is continuous at x = π/2.

For part (b): f(2) = 2(2) − 3 = 1. The Left Hand Derivative = lim(x→2⁻) [(x−1)−1]/(x−2) = lim (x−2)/(x−2) = 1. The Right Hand Derivative = lim(x→2⁺) [(2x−3)−1]/(x−2) = lim 2(x−2)/(x−2) = 2. Since LHD = 1 ≠ RHD = 2, the function is not differentiable at x = 2.
questions.topic: Continuity and differentiability of piecewise functions

questions.text: x के वह मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके लिए f(x) = x^x, x > 0 वर्धमान है।
questions.text_english: Find the values of x for which f(x) = x^x, x > 0 is increasing.

key_points: Let y = x^x, take log: ln y = x ln x
For increasing: x^x(1 + ln x) > 0; since x^x > 0 for x > 0, need 1 + ln x > 0, i.e., ln x > -1, x > e^(-1) = 1/e

questions.solution: Let y = x^x. Taking natural logarithm on both sides, ln y = x ln x. Differentiating with respect to x: (1/y)(dy/dx) = ln x + x · (1/x) = ln x + 1. Therefore dy/dx = x^x (1 + ln x). For f(x) to be increasing, dy/dx > 0. Since x^x > 0 for all x > 0, we need 1 + ln x > 0, which gives ln x > −1, i.e., x > e⁻¹ = 1/e. Hence f(x) is increasing for x > 1/e.

questions.text: यदि तीन बिंदुओं A, B तथा C के स्थिति सदिश क्रमश: 3î + ĵ, 5î + 6ĵ − 3k̂ तथा 4ĵ हैं, तो दर्शाइए कि यह बिंदु एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज बनाते हैं।
questions.text_english: If the position vectors of three points A, B and C are 3î + ĵ, 5î + 6ĵ − 3k̂ and 4ĵ respectively, then show that they form an isosceles triangle.
questions.solution: Let A = (3,1,0), B = (5,6,−3), C = (0,4,0). We compute the three side lengths. AB = B − A = (2, 5, −3), so |AB| = √(4+25+9) = √38. BC = C − B = (−5, −2, 3), so |BC| = √(25+4+9) = √38. CA = A − C = (3, −3, 0), so |CA| = √(9+9+0) = √18. Since |AB| = |BC| = √38 and |CA| = √18, two sides are equal. Therefore the three points form an isosceles triangle.
questions.topic: Position vectors and distance between points

questions.text:
(क) माना भूमि पर पड़ी दो छड़ें सदिशों 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ तथा −2î + ĵ − 2k̂ द्वारा निरूपित की गई हैं। इन दोनों छड़ों के लंबवत 5 m ऊँचाई के एक ध्वज-दण्ड को निरूपित किए जा सकने वाला सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) यदि एक इकाई सदिश ⃗a, x-अक्ष से π/4, y-अक्ष से π/3 तथा z-अक्ष से न्यून कोण θ बना रहा है, तो θ ज्ञात कीजिए तथा ⃗a के घटक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Let two rods placed on the ground be represented by vectors 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ and −2î + ĵ − 2k̂. Find a vector representing a flag-post of height 5 m that has to be erected perpendicular to both the rods.
OR
(b) A unit vector ⃗a is such that it makes an angle π/4 with x-axis, π/3 with y-axis and an acute angle θ with z-axis. Find θ and the components of ⃗a.

key_points: Vector for 5m flag-post = 5 x unit vector = (-5/3)i + (10/3)j + (10/3)k

questions.solution:
For part (a): The vector perpendicular to both rods is given by their cross product. Let u = 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ and v = −2î + ĵ − 2k̂. Then u × v = î[(−1)(−2)−(3)(1)] − ĵ[(4)(−2)−(3)(−2)] + k̂[(4)(1)−(−1)(−2)] = î[2−3] − ĵ[−8+6] + k̂[4−2] = −î + 2ĵ + 2k̂. Its magnitude = √(1+4+4) = 3. Unit vector = (−1/3)î + (2/3)ĵ + (2/3)k̂. The flag-post of height 5 m is represented by 5 × unit vector = −(5/3)î + (10/3)ĵ + (10/3)k̂.

For part (b): Using cos²α + cos²β + cos²θ = 1: cos²(π/4) + cos²(π/3) + cos²θ = 1 gives 1/2 + 1/4 + cos²θ = 1, so cos²θ = 1/4, and since θ is acute, cosθ = 1/2, giving θ = π/3. The components of ⃗a are (1/√2, 1/2, 1/2).

questions.text:
(क) माना A = ℝ − {3} तथा B = ℝ − {1} है। एक फलन f : A → B इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि f(x) = (x − 2)/(x − 3) है। जाँच कीजिए कि क्या f एकैकी व आच्छादी है।
अथवा
(ख) माना n एक निश्चित धन पूर्णांक है तथा संबंध R समुच्चय Z में इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि R = {(x, y) : (x − y), n से भाज्य है, x, y ∈ Z}। ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या R एक तुल्यता संबंध है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Let A = ℝ − {3} and B = ℝ − {1}. A function f : A → B is defined by f(x) = (x − 2)/(x − 3). Find whether f is one-one and onto.
OR
(b) Let n be a fixed positive integer. A relation R is defined in set Z such that R = {(x, y) : (x − y) is divisible by n, x, y ∈ Z}. Determine if R is an equivalence relation.

key_points: Onto: for y in B, solve y(x-3)=x-2 => x=(3y-2)/(y-1) which exists for y≠1 i.e. y∈B, so onto
Symmetric: if n|(x-y) then n|(y-x), so symmetric
Transitive: if n|(x-y) and n|(y-z), then n|(x-z), so transitive; R is equivalence relation

questions.solution:
For part (a): To check one-one, suppose f(x₁) = f(x₂). Then (x₁−2)/(x₁−3) = (x₂−2)/(x₂−3), which gives (x₁−2)(x₂−3) = (x₂−2)(x₁−3). Expanding, x₁x₂ − 3x₁ − 2x₂ + 6 = x₁x₂ − 3x₂ − 2x₁ + 6, giving x₁ = x₂. So f is one-one. For onto, let y ∈ B; then y(x−3) = x−2 gives x = (3y−2)/(y−1), which belongs to A since y ≠ 1. So f is onto.

For part (b): Reflexive: (x−x) = 0, which is divisible by n, so (x,x) ∈ R. Symmetric: if n|(x−y), then n|(y−x), so (y,x) ∈ R. Transitive: if n|(x−y) and n|(y−z), then n|(x−y+y−z) = n|(x−z). So R is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, hence an equivalence relation.
questions.topic: One-one, onto functions and equivalence relations

questions.text:
(क) यदि xy = e^(x−y) है, तो dy/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) tan⁻¹[(√(1+x²) − √(1−x²)) / (√(1+x²) + √(1−x²))] का cos⁻¹ x² के सापेक्ष अवकलज ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If xy = e^(x−y), then find dy/dx.
OR
(b) Differentiate tan⁻¹[(√(1+x²) − √(1−x²)) / (√(1+x²) + √(1−x²))] with respect to cos⁻¹ x².

key_points: (a) Take log: y log x = x - y; y log x + y = x; y(1 + log x) = x; y = x/(1+log x)
Differentiate: dy/dx = [(1+log x)(1) - x(1/x)] / (1+log x)^2 = log x / (1+log x)^2
(b) Let u = tan^{-1}[...]; put x^2 = cos 2t so sqrt(1+x^2) form simplifies; u = pi/4 - t/2; du/d(cos^{-1}x^2) = -1/2

questions.solution:
For part (a): Taking natural log of both sides: ln(xy) = x − y, so y ln x = x − y. Rearranging: y ln x + y = x, giving y(1 + ln x) = x, hence y = x/(1 + ln x). Differentiating: dy/dx = [(1 + ln x)(1) − x(1/x)] / (1 + ln x)² = (1 + ln x − 1) / (1 + ln x)² = ln x / (1 + ln x)².

For part (b): Let x² = cos 2θ. Then √(1+x²) = √(1+cos2θ) = √2 cosθ and √(1−x²) = √(1−cos2θ) = √2 sinθ. The expression inside tan⁻¹ becomes (√2 cosθ − √2 sinθ)/(√2 cosθ + √2 sinθ) = (1−tanθ)/(1+tanθ) = tan(π/4 − θ). So u = tan⁻¹[tan(π/4 − θ)] = π/4 − θ. Since x² = cos 2θ, we have cos⁻¹(x²) = 2θ. Therefore du/d(cos⁻¹ x²) = d(π/4 − θ)/d(2θ) = −(1/2).

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या को ग्राफ द्वारा हल कीजिए :
व्यवरोधों x + y ≤ 300, 3x + y ≤ 600, x − y ≥ −100, x, y ≥ 0 के अंतर्गत Z = 200x + 120y का अधिकतमीकरण कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Solve the following Linear Programming Problem graphically:
Maximise Z = 200x + 120y subject to the constraints x + y ≤ 300, 3x + y ≤ 600, x − y ≥ −100, x, y ≥ 0.

key_points: Corner points of feasible region: O(0,0), A(0,100), B(150,150), C(200,0)

questions.solution: The corner points of the feasible region are found by solving the boundary lines. The intersection of x + y = 300 and 3x + y = 600 gives x = 150, y = 150, so B = (150, 150). The intersection of x + y = 300 and x − y = −100 gives x = 100, y = 200 but we check all vertices: O(0, 0), A(0, 100) from x − y = −100 with x = 0, C(200, 0) from 3x + y = 600 with y = 0, and B(150, 150). Computing Z: at O, Z = 0; at A(0, 100), Z = 12000; at B(150, 150), Z = 200(150) + 120(150) = 30000 + 18000 = 48000; at C(200, 0), Z = 40000. The maximum value of Z is 48000 at (150, 150).

questions.text:
(क) रेखा (x−2)/3 = (1−y)/2 = (z−3)/2 पर एक ऐसा बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिंदु (1, 2, 3) से √2 इकाई की दूरी पर है।
अथवा
(ख) रेखाओं ⃗r = (4+λ)î + (2λ−1)ĵ − 3λk̂ तथा ⃗r = (1+2μ)î + (2−5μ)k̂ + (4μ−1)ĵ के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find a point on the line (x−2)/3 = (1−y)/2 = (z−3)/2 at a distance of √2 units from the point (1, 2, 3).
OR
(b) Find the shortest distance between the lines ⃗r = (4+λ)î + (2λ−1)ĵ − 3λk̂ and ⃗r = (1+2μ)î + (2−5μ)k̂ + (4μ−1)ĵ.
questions.solution:
For part (a): Rewrite the line as (x−2)/3 = (y−1)/(−2) = (z−3)/2 = t. So a general point is P = (2+3t, 1−2t, 3+2t). Distance from (1,2,3) = √2 gives (1+3t)² + (2t−1)² + (2t)² = 2 ⇒ 1+6t+9t² + 4t²−4t+1 + 4t² = 2 ⇒ 17t²+2t = 0 ⇒ t(17t+2) = 0. So t = 0 gives point (2,1,3) and t = −2/17 gives (28/17, 21/17, 47/17).

For part (b): Write lines as ⃗r = (4î − ĵ) + λ(î + 2ĵ − 3k̂) and ⃗r = (î − ĵ) + μ(2î + 4ĵ − 5k̂). Here a₂ − a₁ = −3î + 0ĵ, b₁ × b₂ = |î ĵ k̂; 1 2 -3; 2 4 -5| = (10−12)î − (−5+6)ĵ + (4−4)k̂ = −2î − ĵ. |b₁ × b₂| = √5. SD = |(−3î)·(−2î−ĵ)| / √5 = |6| / √5 = 6/√5 = 6√5/5.
questions.topic: Point on a line at a given distance and shortest distance between skew lines

questions.text: एक स्कूल में, वाद-विवाद प्रतियोगिता करवाने की प्रायिकता 1/3 है जबकि प्रश्नोत्तरी प्रतियोगिता रखने की प्रायिकता 2/3 है। भाग लेने वाली टीमों में टीम A में 4 लड़कियाँ तथा 6 लड़के हैं, जबकि टीम B में 7 लड़कियाँ तथा 3 लड़के हैं। यदि वाद-विवाद प्रतियोगिता होती है, तो टीम A में से विद्यार्थी चुने जाते हैं, जबकि प्रश्नोत्तरी प्रतियोगिता के लिए टीम B में से विद्यार्थियों का चयन होना है। यदि टीमों में से केवल दो विद्यार्थी चुनने हैं, तो एक लड़का तथा एक लड़की के चुने जाने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In a school, the probability of holding a debate competition is 1/3 and that of a quiz competition is 2/3. In the two participating teams, A has 4 girls and 6 boys and B has 7 girls and 3 boys. If a debate competition is held, the students are selected from team A and for the quiz competition they are selected from team B. If only two students are to be chosen from the teams, then find the probability that one will be a girl and the other a boy.
questions.solution: P(debate) = 1/3, P(quiz) = 2/3. Team A has 10 students (4 girls, 6 boys); Team B has 10 students (7 girls, 3 boys). P(1 girl and 1 boy | debate, from A) = C(4,1)×C(6,1)/C(10,2) = 24/45 = 8/15. P(1 girl and 1 boy | quiz, from B) = C(7,1)×C(3,1)/C(10,2) = 21/45 = 7/15. By total probability, P(1 girl and 1 boy) = (1/3)(8/15) + (2/3)(7/15) = 8/45 + 14/45 = 22/45.

questions.text:
(क) ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ x / [(x−1)(x²+4)] dx
अथवा
(ख) मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫₀¹ x tan⁻¹x / (1+x²)^(3/2) dx
questions.text_english:
(a) Find: ∫ x / [(x−1)(x²+4)] dx
OR
(b) Evaluate: ∫₀¹ x tan⁻¹x / (1+x²)^(3/2) dx

key_points: (b) Use integration by parts with u=tan^{-1}x, dv=x/(1+x^2)^{3/2} dx

questions.solution:
For part (a): Using partial fractions, x/[(x−1)(x²+4)] = A/(x−1) + (Bx+C)/(x²+4). Multiplying out: x = A(x²+4) + (Bx+C)(x−1). Setting x=1: 1 = 5A, so A = 1/5. Expanding and comparing coefficients: B = −1/5 and C = 4/5. Therefore the integral = (1/5)∫dx/(x−1) + ∫(−1/5)x/(x²+4) dx + (4/5)∫dx/(x²+4) = (1/5)ln|x−1| − (1/10)ln(x²+4) + (2/5)tan⁻¹(x/2) + C.

For part (b): Let u = tan⁻¹x and dv = x(1+x²)^⁻³ᐟ² dx. Then du = 1/(1+x²) dx and v = −1/√(1+x²). By integration by parts: [−tan⁻¹x/√(1+x²)]₀¹ + ∫₀¹ 1/[(1+x²)^(3/2) × √(1+x²)] · √(1+x²) dx = [−tan⁻¹x/√(1+x²)]₀¹ + ∫₀¹ dx/(1+x²) = −π/(4√2) + 0 + [tan⁻¹x]₀¹ = −π/(4√2) + π/4 = π/4 × (1 − 1/√2).
questions.topic: Integration by partial fractions and integration by parts

questions.text: समाकलन के प्रयोग से वक्र y = |x − 6|, x-अक्ष, तथा x = 4 से x = 8 के बीच परिबद्ध क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Using integration, find the area of the region enclosed by the curve y = |x − 6|, the x-axis, and between x = 4 and x = 8.
questions.topic: Area bounded by a curve and the x-axis

questions.text:
(क) अवकल समीकरण y e^y dx = (y³ + 2x e^y) dy, जब y(0) = 1 को हल कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) अवकल समीकरण (x³ − 3xy²) dx = (y³ − 3x²y) dy का व्यापक हल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Solve the differential equation y e^y dx = (y³ + 2x e^y) dy, when y(0) = 1.
OR
(b) Find the general solution of the differential equation (x³ − 3xy²) dx = (y³ − 3x²y) dy.

key_points: (a) Rewrite as dx/dy = (y^3 + 2x e^y)/(y e^y) = y^2 e^{-y} + 2x/y
dx/dy - 2x/y = y^2 e^{-y}; IF = e^{-2 ln y} = 1/y^2
(b) (x^3 - 3xy^2)dx = (y^3 - 3x^2y)dy; rearrange: x^3 dx - y^3 dy = 3xy^2 dx - 3x^2y dy

questions.solution:
For part (a): Rewrite as dx/dy − (2/y)x = y² e^⁻y (a linear ODE in x). Integrating factor = e^(∫−2/y dy) = e^⁻²ˡʸ y = 1/y². Multiply both sides: d(x/y²)/dy = e^⁻y. Integrating: x/y² = −e^⁻y + C. Using y(0) = 1 means when y = 1, x = 0: 0/1 = −e^⁻¹ + C gives C = e^⁻¹. So x/y² = e^⁻¹ − e^⁻y, i.e., x = y²(e^⁻¹ − e^⁻y).

For part (b): Rearrange as (x³ − 3xy²)dx − (y³ − 3x²y)dy = 0. This is a homogeneous equation. Put y = vx, dy = v dx + x dv. Substituting and simplifying leads to separation of variables: the equation reduces to d(x⁴ − y⁴) = 0 after regrouping, giving x⁴ − y⁴ = C(x² + y²) as the general solution, or equivalently x⁴ − y⁴ = C(x² + y²).

questions.text: उस रेखा का सदिश तथा कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो रेखाओं (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z−3)/4 तथा (x−4)/5 = (y−1)/2 = z के प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु से होकर जाए तथा सदिश 3î + 2ĵ − 8k̂ के समांतर हो।
questions.text_english: Find the equation of a line (in vector and cartesian form) that passes through the point of intersection of lines (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z−3)/4 and (x−4)/5 = (y−1)/2 = z and is parallel to the vector 3î + 2ĵ − 8k̂.
questions.solution: Line L₁ parametrically: (1+2s, 2+3s, 3+4s) and Line L₂: (4+5t, 1+2t, t). For intersection, equating z: 3+4s = t. Substituting into the y-equation: 2+3s = 1+2(3+4s) = 7+8s, so −5s = 5, giving s = −1 and t = −1. The intersection point is (1+2(−1), 2+3(−1), 3+4(−1)) = (−1, −1, −1). The required line passes through (−1, −1, −1) and is parallel to 3î + 2ĵ − 8k̂. Vector equation: ⃗r = (−î − ĵ − k̂) + λ(3î + 2ĵ − 8k̂). Cartesian equation: (x+1)/3 = (y+1)/2 = (z+1)/(−8).
questions.topic: Equation of a line through intersection of two lines

questions.text: एक बर्थडे पार्टी पर, बच्चों को शंक्वाकार कपों में संतरे का जूस दिया जा रहा था, जैसा कि आकृति में दर्शाया गया है। प्रत्येक कप की गहराई 15 cm है तथा त्रिज्या 5 cm है। इस कप में जूस 0.1 cm³/s की दर से डाला जा रहा है।
questions.text_english: At a birthday party, children are being served orange juice in conical cups, as shown in the figure. Each cup is 15 cm deep and has a radius 5 cm. The juice is being poured into this cup at a rate of 0.1 cm³/s.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions:
questions.solution: Case study on rates of change in a conical cup. Answers are in sub-questions.

sub_questions.text: कप में जूस की ऊँचाई h तथा कप में जूस के पृष्ठ की त्रिज्या r में संबंध स्थापित कीजिए जबकि शंकु का अर्ध-शीर्ष कोण α है।
sub_questions.text_english: Establish a relation between the height h of the juice in the cup and radius r of the surface of the juice in the cup, if the semi-vertical angle of the cone is α.

key_points: tan(alpha) = R/H = 5/15 = 1/3, so r/h = 1/3, giving r = h/3

sub_questions.solution: Since the cone has R = 5 cm and H = 15 cm, the semi-vertical angle α satisfies tanα = R/H = 5/15 = 1/3. By similar triangles, at any depth h, the radius r of the juice surface satisfies r/h = tanα = 1/3. Therefore r = h/3.

sub_questions.text: कप में जूस का तल किस दर से ऊपर चढ़ रहा है, जब कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है ?
sub_questions.text_english: At what rate is the juice level in the cup rising when the juice is 6 cm deep ?
sub_questions.solution: Using r = h/3, the volume V = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3)π(h/3)²h = πh³/27. Differentiating: dV/dt = (3πh²/27) dh/dt = (πh²/9) dh/dt. Given dV/dt = 0.1 and h = 6: 0.1 = π(36)/9 × dh/dt = 4π × dh/dt. Therefore dh/dt = 0.1/(4π) = 1/(40π) cm/s.

sub_questions.text:
(क) जिस समय कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है, उस समय जूस के ऊपरी पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) जब कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है, उस समय कप के गीले पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (wetted surface area) के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) When the juice is 6 cm deep, then find at what rate is the upper surface area of juice increasing.
OR
(b) When the juice is 6 cm deep, then find the rate at which the wetted surface area of the cup is increasing.

key_points: (b) Curved surface S = pi r l = pi r sqrt(r^2+h^2) = pi(h/3)sqrt(h^2/9+h^2) = pi(h/3)(h*sqrt(10)/3) = pi h^2 sqrt(10)/9; dS/dt = 2pi h sqrt(10)/9 * dh/dt = 2pi(6)sqrt(10)/9 * 1/(40pi) = sqrt(10)/30 cm^2/s

sub_questions.solution:
For part (a): The upper surface area A = πr² = πh²/9. Differentiating: dA/dt = (2πh/9) dh/dt. At h = 6 and dh/dt = 1/(40π): dA/dt = (12π/9)(1/40π) = 12/(360) = 1/30 cm²/s.

For part (b): The slant height l = √(r²+h²) = √(h²/9+h²) = h√10/3. Curved (wetted) surface area S = πrl = π(h/3)(h√10/3) = πh²√10/9. Differentiating: dS/dt = (2πh√10/9) dh/dt. At h = 6: dS/dt = (12π√10/9)(1/40π) = 12√10/360 = √10/30 cm²/s.

questions.topic: Rate of change of volume and surface area

questions.text: एक NGO ने एक चैरिटी इवेंट आयोजित किया जिसमें उन्होंने बच्चों को सर्दी से बचाने के लिए ऊनी टोपियाँ बाँटने का फैसला किया। बाँटने वाली टोपियाँ तीन अलग-अलग बक्सों में हैं, बॉक्स I में 30 लाल रंग की टोपियाँ हैं, बॉक्स II में 20 लाल तथा 10 हरी टोपियाँ हैं, तथा बॉक्स III में 30 हरे रंग की टोपियाँ हैं। बॉक्स i चुनकर उसमें से एक टोपी लेने की प्रायिकता i/6 है, जहाँ i = 1, 2, 3 है।
questions.text_english: An NGO organises a charity event in which they decide to distribute woollen caps to protect children from winter. The caps to be distributed are in three separate boxes, Box I has 30 red caps, Box II has 20 red and 10 green caps, and Box III has 30 green caps. The probability that a Box i is selected and a cap picked out is i/6, where i = 1, 2, 3.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना पर आधारित, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए : एक व्यक्ति एक टोपी चुनता है।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions. A person selects a cap.
questions.solution: Case study on Bayes' theorem and total probability. Answers in sub-questions.

sub_questions.text: उसके एक लाल रंग की टोपी चुनने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that he selects a red cap ?

sub_questions.text: यदि वह एक हरी टोपी चुनता है, तो इस टोपी के बॉक्स II में से चुने जाने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: If he selects a green cap, what is the probability that the cap has come from Box II ?
sub_questions.solution: P(green | Box I) = 0, P(green | Box II) = 10/30 = 1/3, P(green | Box III) = 1. P(green) = (1/6)(0) + (2/6)(1/3) + (3/6)(1) = 0 + 2/18 + 9/18 = 11/18. By Bayes' theorem, P(Box II | green) = P(Box II) × P(green | Box II) / P(green) = (1/3)(1/3) / (11/18) = (1/9) × (18/11) = 2/11.
